title: fix(gateway): keep event lineage current across session lifetimes
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes stale parent-session attribution and permanently retained lineage lookups when many Control UI sessions are created, replaced, or removed.

## User Impact

Agent and chat events follow current prepared controller and parent-session facts. Deleted sessions, closed incognito stores, and disposed projections no longer retain a cached parent. Optional enrichment can be absent while its owner prepares facts. No protocol, configuration, or SQLite schema changes are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The event handler used a permanent map for both successful and missing lineage lookups. Its initial lookup could also read SQLite on the Gateway thread. Events now consume the session projection owner and writer-published incognito metadata without materializing rows or rebuilding registry indexes during ingestion. Stored lineage remains canonical even when display aliases differ.

The lineage reader lives with existing projection relation reads; the sharing-entry constructor moved beside its type to keep both modules within their line caps. Production grows by 29 lines because preserving canonical selection and private-store lifetimes needs more than deleting the obsolete map.

## Evidence

- Baseline regression proof: eight scenarios failed for stale controller/null/positive results and SQL during the first prepared lookup (six statements in the basic case). Command wall time: 791.02 s on the shared campaign host.
- Focused handler and incognito proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-chat.subagent-lineage.test.ts src/gateway/server-chat.agent-events.test.ts src/gateway/session-row-projection.incognito.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 234 passed, 731.57 s wall before the behavior-preserving helper extraction. Lineage cases subsequently consolidated onto one admitted physical store and projection, retaining all lifecycle assertions.
- Canonical stored-lineage and resource-policy proof: 16 passed, 753.51 s wall. Consolidated lineage-only proof: one lifecycle test passed, 28.620 s test time / 371.75 s command wall. Worker preparation and imports dominate wall time; one real-store fixture protects publication ordering, normalization, and incognito lifetime together.
- Final helper-extraction proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-chat.subagent-lineage.test.ts src/gateway/session-resource-tool-policy.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 16 passed; 1,201.11 s wall. The lineage test took 44.694 s on this run; the real writer/projection/ephemeral-store composition cannot be protected by a mocked lookup test. One shared fixture covers all transitions; no polling, sleeps, or Gateway boots were added.
- Actual-handler microbenchmark, 10,000 distinct synthetic eligible missing session keys: 1,826.213 ms before → 83.635 ms after; retained heap delta 1,936,296 B → 185,136 B (90.4% lower). After dropping the handler: 565,952 B → 93,072 B. One paired isolated observation on Node 26.9.0, not a live Gateway latency or GC-pause measurement. No sockets or live state used.
- Production LOC: +87 / -58, net +29. Tests and support: +182 / -125, net +57. Two obsolete cache-specific tests were replaced by real-owner publication and zero-SQL assertions.
- Deslop complete. Line-cap ratchet passed after cohesive extraction; no suppression added.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs`: 2,431.90 s wall; all production and 25 test type graphs, structural guards, and dead-export scans passed. Final lint found one shadowed local parameter. Renamed it without changing behavior; the exact changed-file lint command replay passed (exit 0), 141.73 s wall. Formatting and line-cap checks passed again. Earlier valid functional and type proof is reused for this naming-only correction.
- Review regression: an actual-handler probe reproduced canonical main-alias lookup choosing stored lineage over its registry controller. Exact-row selection now lets the existing selector own alias fallback; the probe passes and the same case is included in the lifecycle test. Final `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-chat.subagent-lineage.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: passed, 461.70 s wall / 33.410 s test time, including zero-SQL assertions for all lifecycle and alias transitions.
- Independent Codex branch review through P2: final committed branch scoped-clean, no accepted/actionable findings. The initial alias finding was reproduced and fixed; the final lint correction only renames a local parameter. Candidate head: `c516733b626827edd2c8bcef9c6087b61f4c5a03`.


### Landing verification

Merged current main `76e32e92441321b2e564263bc385cc7f4cc8ecd7` into the reviewed branch without rebasing. The sole textual conflict was the relocated sharing-entry constructor: the resolution preserves main's `archivedAt` and this change's `spawnedBy` together. Main's chat projection and presence work remains intact. Candidate: `f4f0728cacf5fb7e71ab269dc764496d0475bc1e`.

- Local focused lineage, server-chat agent-event, and incognito projection tests: 227 passed; 541.01 s command wall (lineage lifecycle case: 13.524 s).
- Independent Codex review of the merged candidate through P2: scoped-clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01m3dv1hc5rz7xczgwkrx99h6n`: `node scripts/check-changed.mjs --base origin/main` passed, 1,597.70 s command wall. Production and all 25 test type graphs, structural guards, dead-export scans, and lint passed. Source hashes were verified. [Run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36213944999). The box is confirmed stopped/completed; its backing workflow may show cancellation from normal delegated lease cleanup. Runner portal sync warned after the successful command and confirmed shutdown.
- Two local invocation preflights were corrected before allocation: the source wrapper requires an `origin/<branch>` base, and Blacksmith does not support the generic `--stop-after` flag. Exactly one Testbox was allocated.
- Exact-head hosted CI [run 36215569396](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36215569396): completed successfully for `f4f0728cacf5fb7e71ab269dc764496d0475bc1e`; repository watcher returned `GREEN`. No failed jobs or test reruns. The watcher retried one read when the rollup changed during pagination.
